subject: [hw] DONE opus-mm21: MM21 layout facts + n2_mm21 detile (C + NEON) + output-path proposal; N2TEST MM21 PASS 5/5
body: N2TEST MM21 PASS 5/5 (bash gpu/hwcodec/mm21/run_tests.sh; 4 host builds x 167 checks incl. 13 libyuv black-box comparisons, + arm64-ios16 compile with NEON path). Host-tested and compiled for iOS only; real NEON never executed; nothing on the phone. Not done: phone confirmation of the layout (facts/MM21_LAYOUT.md section 6), phone timing, 10-bit/UFO formats (out of scope), DEC06 integration and the DEC_PICTURE_OK crop field (proposed to DEC06/DEC05/lead2). Files: gpu/hwcodec/mm21/{n2_mm21.h,n2_mm21.c,n2_mm21_neon_emu.h,t_mm21.c,run_tests.sh,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/facts/MM21_LAYOUT.md (new). Facts for hw-d01: MM21 = V4L2_PIX_FMT_MT21 in this kernel (videodev2.h:684,739) [V]; both planes stride buf_w, C = Y/2 (mtk_vcodec_dec.c:1044-1054) [V]; UFO threshold 0x1fe000 = 1920*1088 so 1080p needs layout.mode=0 [V-host]; tile formula agrees with libyuv [V-oracle], equals real VDEC [I].
